rules: All subagents and main agent processes MUST use ultra-low RAM so the Contabo VPS never freezes, stops, or crashes.
Stream scraped leads directly to disk CSVs and NDJSON staging files; call gc.collect() and release memory buffers immediately after each batch.
Limit concurrent active worker threads in the 313-subagent pool to safe low-RAM concurrency while queuing all 313 category subagents until 100% completion.

The Whole South African Internet (.co.za & SA Web)

minimum_required_fields: Phone number or telephone number or WhatsApp number
strict_data_hygiene: Every captured detail must be placed in its exact corresponding CSV column with zero column shifting.

Emails must be validated and placed strictly in the 'Email or emails' column AND also logged into the dedicated outreach CSV file ('all_businesses_with_emails_for_level2_outreach.csv') with Business name, Province, City/Town, Suburb, Category, Phone, and Email.
Zero duplicate businesses with the same details (deduplicated by normalized business name + phone/email/address).

Once all 313 categories are captured, email all CSVs to nicholauscostochetty@gmail.com, store them permanently on the VPS, and upload/sync all listings to searchbiz.co.za in their exact Province, City/Town, Suburb/Area, Postal Code, and Category.

website_display_and_search_rules.no_search_limits: When searching on searchbiz.co.za under Province, City/Town/Area, Suburb, or Category via the Search Console Bar or Directory, it must show ALL matching results with NO artificial limits.
website_display_and_search_rules.level_1_public_display_rule: Ad uploads to searchbiz.co.za (Level 1 Unclaimed/Free) must ONLY publicly show: (1) Business Name, (2) Full Address, and (3) Phone Number or Telephone Number (or if no phone/telephone number is present, use the WhatsApp number as the phone number). Everything else (About the business, Services offered, Trading hours, Website link, Emails, Social media links: X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) MUST be blurred out on the site because those belong to Paid Level 2+ tiers.

telegram_commands_permanent./mega_swarm 313: Spawns 313 category subagents to scrape all 9 provinces and all 6,931 suburbs across Google Maps, Google Business Profile, Facebook, business directory websites, and the whole SA internet; saves clean CSVs + email outreach vault, emails all to nicholauscostochetty@gmail.com, stores in VPS, and uploads all to searchbiz.co.za.
telegram_commands_permanent./subagents_status: Shows the live status of all 313 subagents (whether they are actively working or idle, current group/category, province, scraped count, uploaded ads count, and VPS RAM usage).
telegram_commands_permanent./listings: Shows all stored CSV listings and total businesses captured on the VPS and synced to searchbiz.co.za.
telegram_commands_permanent./email all listings to: Interactive and direct command allowing Nicholaus to enter any target email address (or '/email all listings to someone@example.com') to immediately email all stored business listing CSVs to that address.
telegram_commands_permanent./outreach_emails: Emails all captured businesses that have email addresses inviting them to visit searchbiz.co.za, verify their business listing(s), and upgrade to the paid Level 2 option (R199.00/month) to unlock and display all their business contact information, links, and details.

outreach_campaign_memory.purpose: Contact all scraped businesses that have emails in the CSV vault to visit https://searchbiz.co.za, claim/verify their business listing, and upgrade to Paid Level 2 (R199.00/month) so SearchBiz.co.za unblurs and displays all their business contact information, emails, website link, WhatsApp, and social media links.
